verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 1Password stores one-time passwords and has vaults, but nothing documents shared team vaults, sharing TOTP logins with teammates, or per-member access control. Vault references only cover CLI listing and Connect access for company apps, which is adjacent, not team sharing with member-level permissions.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
